mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id AS kbId, name AS fileName, current_parse_generation AS parseGeneration, parse_status AS parseStatus, multimodal_enabled AS multimodalEnabled FROM kb_file_node WHERE id = #{fileId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND node_type = 'file' AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(chunk_type, 'text') AS chunkType, COALESCE(section_type, '') AS sectionType, COUNT(*) AS chunkCount, MIN(page_start) AS pageStart, MAX(page_end) AS pageEnd FROM kb_chunk WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_node_id = #{fileId} AND parse_generation = #{parseGeneration} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY chunk_type, section_type ORDER BY chunkCount DESC

SELECT section_id AS sectionId, parent_section_id AS parentSectionId, section_title AS sectionTitle, section_path AS sectionPath, section_level AS sectionLevel, section_type AS sectionType, seq_start AS seqStart, seq_end AS seqEnd, page_start AS pageStart, page_end AS pageEnd, covered_chunk_ids_json AS coveredChunkIdsJson, block_ids AS blockIds, metadata_json AS metadataJson FROM kb_section WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_node_id = #{fileId} AND parse_generation = #{parseGeneration} ORDER BY seq_start ASC, section_level ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, section_id AS sectionId, section_title AS sectionTitle, section_path AS sectionPath, section_level AS sectionLevel, summary_type AS summaryType, node_summary AS nodeSummary, structured_summary_json AS structuredSummaryJson, covered_chunk_ids_json AS coveredChunkIdsJson, summary_source AS summarySource, confidence FROM kb_section_summary WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_node_id = #{fileId} AND parse_generation = #{parseGeneration} ORDER BY section_level ASC, id ASC

SELECT unit_id AS unitId, unit_type AS unitType, unit_subtype AS unitSubtype, anchor_id AS anchorId, subject_text AS subjectText, predicate_text AS predicateText, object_text AS objectText, value_type AS valueType, normalized_json AS normalizedJson, source_section_id AS sourceSectionId, primary_chunk_id AS primaryChunkId, evidence_quote AS evidenceQuote, confidence, status, metadata_json AS metadataJson FROM kb_knowledge_unit WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_node_id = #{fileId} AND parse_generation = #{parseGeneration} AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY CASE unit_type WHEN 'process_step' THEN 1 WHEN 'rule' THEN 2 WHEN 'condition' THEN 3 WHEN 'responsibility' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, id ASC LIMIT 300

SELECT anchor_id AS anchorId, anchor_type AS anchorType, anchor_name AS anchorName, normalized_name AS normalizedName, aliases_json AS aliasesJson, source_section_id AS sourceSectionId, source_chunk_id AS sourceChunkId, evidence_quote AS evidenceQuote, confidence, status, metadata_json AS metadataJson FROM kb_anchor_registry WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_node_id = #{fileId} AND parse_generation = #{parseGeneration} AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY confidence DESC, id ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT relation_id AS relationId, relation_type AS relationType, from_type AS fromType, from_id AS fromId, to_type AS toType, to_id AS toId, source_chunk_id AS sourceChunkId, evidence_quote AS evidenceQuote, confidence, status, metadata_json AS metadataJson FROM kb_relation WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_node_id = #{fileId} AND parse_generation = #{parseGeneration} AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY confidence DESC, id ASC LIMIT 300
